entry.title: Notes of analysis
entry.content:
About 2 years ago I started recording my math notes with $\LaTeX$ then submit to GitHub. In total I wrote 2 pieces of notes, one about analysis including real analysis, functional analysis and some probability theory, and one about statistics including linear models, simulations and sampling techniques. Both of them are naive, however, they record my thoughts and reward in math learning. These contents are introduction to math to me, that is to say the learning process will continue as long as the passion does not fade out (which I believe will not happen). Here is the repository:

For some reasons they are not uploaded for about a year, I think I will extend these contents in the future.
